name: tally-use
expected_first_action: Run tally status, read tally.json to understand task state, identify the task lane (round execution, task CRUD, validation, or handoff), then choose the minimal CLI command.
positive_triggers: Manage tasks in a Tally-enabled repository
Start or close an execution round
Mark tasks as done, blocked, or unblocked
Add newly discovered tasks to the ledger
Run tally lint, tally check, or tally status
Visualize ledger data with tally dashboard
Export ledger data with tally export
negative_triggers: Edit a generic todo list outside a Tally ledger
Track tasks in chat memory without writing to tally.json
Edit tally.json directly instead of using CLI commands
